errors.evidence: search_agent was used to query Arxiv API despite being defined as a web search tool
errors.description: The search_agent tool was misconfigured to perform API queries instead of web searches, violating its defined purpose.
errors.impact: Incorrect tool usage led to unreliable data retrieval and processing.

errors.evidence: Query parameters 'cat:hep-lat AND submittedDate:[2020-01-01 TO 2020-01-31]' used invalid Arxiv API syntax
errors.description: Invalid query format resulted in incomplete/incorrect article filtering, leading to wrong PS version count.
errors.impact: Misconfigured query parameters caused undercounting of articles (reported 12 vs actual 31).

scores.reliability_reasoning: Tool misuse and query errors caused significant answer inaccuracies.
scores.security_reasoning: No evidence of API key exposure, but improper tool configuration poses potential risks.
scores.instruction_adherence_reasoning: Answer format was correct but content violated accuracy requirements.
scores.plan_opt_reasoning: Over-reliance on faulty tool and query logic led to suboptimal execution.
